title: project_paths misses an scp-style remote without a user and can crash on a non-ASCII remote
goal: bl_base.project_paths reads host:group/project remotes (no user) and decodes git's output as UTF-8 with replacement, so a non-ASCII remote never crashes backlog.py check. Found by the SP-2agxqrrv review.

run: import sys, subprocess, tempfile; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import bl_base as b; d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', d]); subprocess.run(['git', '-C', d, 'remote', 'add', 'o', 'gitlab.example.com:grp/proj.git']); sys.exit(0 if 'grp/proj' in b.project_paths(d) else 1)
